checks.run:
import json, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.reality_check import inspect_reality_intent, run_reality_check, write_reality_check_artifacts
from factoryline.graph_ops import graph_ops_snapshot
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root=Path(raw)
    e2e={"schema":"factory.e2e_proof_manifest.v1","id":"smoke-e2e","approval":{"state":"approved","approved_by":"smoke-owner"},"working_directory":".","timeout_seconds":10,"network_egress":"not_granted","positive":{"argv":[sys.executable,"-c","from pathlib import Path; Path('artifact.txt').write_text('ok')"]},"negative":{"argv":[sys.executable,"-c","import sys; sys.exit(1)"]},"artifact_paths":["artifact.txt"]}
    (root/'e2e.json').write_text(json.dumps(e2e),encoding='utf-8')
    reality={"schema":"factory.reality-check-manifest.v1","id":"smoke-behavior","approval":{"state":"approved","approved_by":"smoke-owner"},"behavior":{"promise":"A user sees a saved value.","happy_path":"A save records the value.","failure_case":"A denied save is not recorded."},"intent_assertions":[{"id":"save-recorded","statement":"The approved save is recorded.","evidence":"positive"},{"id":"denied-save","statement":"The denied save cannot succeed.","evidence":"negative"}],"e2e_manifest":"e2e.json"}
    path=root/'reality.json'; path.write_text(json.dumps(reality),encoding='utf-8')
    assert inspect_reality_intent(root,path)['marker']=='REALITY_INTENT_CONTRACT_READY'
    receipt=run_reality_check(root,path); assert receipt['marker']=='REALITY_CHECK_VERIFIED'; assert all(item['verified'] for item in receipt['intent_verification'])
    write_reality_check_artifacts(receipt,root/'.factory'/'reality')
    assert any(node['kind']=='reality_check' for node in graph_ops_snapshot(root)['nodes'])
print('REALITY_CHECK_SMOKE_PASS')
